jobs.description:
**OpusClip** **is the world's No.1 AI video agent, built for authenticity on social media.**

Check out our latest coverage by Business Insider featuring our product and funding milestones, and our recognition as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2024.

Headquartered in Mountain View, we are a team of 100 passionate and experienced AI enthusiasts and video experts, driven by our core values:

* Be a Champion Team
* Prioritize Ruthlessly
* Ship fast, Quality Follows
* Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

**About the Role**
------------------

OpusClip is looking for a staff-level, product-oriented Data Science leader to build an effective and increasingly AI-native data function.

You will set priorities for a small Data team, personally lead our hardest analytical problems, improve how we measure product and business performance, and build systems that help teams make better decisions with less manual analytical work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You may lead through direct management or technical leadership; formal people management is not required. We care more about your ability to lead through judgment, technical depth, and example.

You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI across product analytics, experimentation, user intelligence, data quality, growth measurement, AI data flywheels, and agentic analytics.

This expands the existing role from owning trusted metrics and analyses into setting direction and creating leverage across the Data function.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the Data function**

* Set priorities for a small Data team and focus limited capacity on the highest-impact problems.
* Personally lead ambiguous or high-stakes analytical projects.
* Raise standards for metrics, experimentation, analytical quality, and decision-making.
* Lead and develop Data Scientists, analysts, and Data Engineers through technical direction and example.
* Reduce repetitive and reactive work by turning recurring problems into reusable systems and processes.

### **Drive product and business decisions**

* Analyze activation, retention, segmentation, monetization, user behavior, and lifetime value.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.
* Identify opportunities where Data can directly improve key company metrics.
* Build stronger user profiling and segmentation to inform product strategy, operations, and company goal setting.
* Improve experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth.

The existing JD already emphasizes turning product and customer data into business decisions; this role owns that mandate at a broader level.

### **Improve data quality and measurement**

* Establish trusted definitions and validation for critical product and business metrics.
* Identify systematic issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, tables, and dashboards.
* Partner with Data Engineering and Engineering to prevent recurring data problems rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms.
* Build reusable datasets, metric definitions, monitoring, and analytical frameworks that improve self-service.

You do not need to be a data infrastructure expert, but you should be technically strong enough to diagnose how data moves through a system, identify systemic failure modes, and work effectively with engineers to fix them.

### **Build Growth intelligence**

* Help Growth understand acquisition quality, retention, LTV, and the true value of different channels and customer segments.
* Improve performance marketing measurement beyond surface-level attribution toward experimentation and incrementality.
* Identify opportunities to improve CAC, conversion, retention, monetization, or other major business metrics.
* Build horizontal analytical tools and frameworks that enable Growth and Product teams to run better experiments and make faster decisions.

### **Partner with our AI teams**

* Support data curation, evaluation design, experimentation, and measurement for AI-powered product experiences.
* Identify product behavior that can become useful evaluation data, feedback signals, or failure cases.
* Connect AI quality with real user behavior and business outcomes.
* Strengthen the loop from **product usage data AI improvement better product**.

Model training experience is not required. The existing role already includes AI evaluation, curation, and online/offline measurement; this senior role is expected to make that collaboration systematic.

### **Build AI-native analytics**

* Use AI to automate recurring analytical work and improve the productivity of the Data team.
* Build trusted self-service tools for Product and business teams.
* Explore agentic systems that can detect unusual metric movements, identify contributing segments, generate hypotheses, and investigate likely causes.
* Help move the company from dashboards and one-off analysis toward proactive business intelligence.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Significant experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent scope, regardless of formal title.
* Strong product and business judgment. You identify important questions instead of waiting for them to be assigned.
* Strong SQL and Python skills and a willingness to remain hands-on.
*

The Staff Research Associate provides technical and operational support for biomedical research studies and laboratory activities. * Ability to follow detailed laboratory protocols and standard operating procedures.

* Ability to work independently on routine tasks while seeking guidance when appropriate.

* Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

The Chemical Lab Technician I performs routine laboratory sampling, analysis, process-control support, and equipment checks for chemical milling, chemical cleaning, wastewater treatment, and related aerospace manufacturing processes. jobs.title: Lab Technician - Data Center & Network Operations
jobs.description:
**Title: Lab Technician**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA(Onsite)**

**Type: 6+ Month Contract**

**Rate: $Open /hr.**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a **Lab / Data Center Technician** with 1–3 years of experience in a laboratory or data center environment. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with equipment rack and stack, network cabling, device auditing, basic networking, VMware, Windows, and Linux administration. The candidate should also have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage ticket queues and respond to requests within SLA requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Enable remote access to lab services for end users through **SSL VPN, RDP, VNC, and View Client**.
* Perform **rack and stack** activities for network and lab equipment.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and presentable lab environment.
* Identify different types of network cables, connectors, and their appropriate applications.
* Audit physical and virtual devices, including **connections, serial numbers, and IP addresses**.
* Maintain and update lab and infrastructure documentation.
* Act as a **ticket queue lead**, monitoring incoming tickets and assigning or reassigning tickets to appropriate team members or groups.
* Review incoming requests and ticket updates daily and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* Build and cable network topologies based on requirements from Engineers and Lab Administrators.
* Monitor **power and cooling usage** within the lab and identify potential issues.
* Perform basic troubleshooting of network outages and connectivity issues.
* Use **SSH and console access** to connect to network devices.
* Follow established SLA requirements and prioritize tickets appropriately.
* Communicate clearly through email, messaging, and ticket updates.
* Maintain strong follow-up and responsiveness to user and engineering requests.
* Follow proper safety and equipment-handling procedures, including the ability to lift equipment weighing **50+ lbs.**

  
  
**Requirements**  

* 2 **–3 years of experience** working in a **lab, data center, network operations, or similar technical environment**
* Basic network troubleshooting skills.
* Basic experience working with **firewalls**.
* Hands-on experience with **Cisco and/or Arista switches** is preferred.
* Basic **Windows administration** experience.
* Basic **VMware** administration, including powering VMs on/off.
* Basic experience with **CentOS, Ubuntu, or other Linux distributions**.
* Strong understanding of **copper and fiber-optic cabling**.
* Experience with **fiber and copper cable installation and management** in a data center environment.

**About the Lin Laboratory**
============================

The Lin Laboratory at USC studies the molecular mechanisms that drive cancer development, progression, immune evasion, and therapeutic response, with a particular focus on head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) and other upper aerodigestive cancers. Our research integrates cancer genomics and epigenomics with functional biology, patient-derived organoid models, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, and tumor immunology.

A major strength of the laboratory is the development and application of human organoid models. These models are integrated with clinical specimens and multi-omic datasets to address biologically and clinically relevant questions.

The laboratory is embedded within the USC Head and Neck Center and the USC Norris Comprehensive Cancer Center, providing a highly collaborative environment with access to clinicians, patient specimens, advanced genomic technologies, and multidisciplinary expertise. * Be a Champion Team
* Prioritize Ruthlessly
* Ship fast, Quality Follows
* Obsess over customers

Be a part of this exciting journey with us!

**About the Role**
------------------

OpusClip is looking for a staff-level, product-oriented Data Science leader to build an effective and increasingly AI-native data function.

You will set priorities for a small Data team, personally lead our hardest analytical problems, improve how we measure product and business performance, and build systems that help teams make better decisions with less manual analytical work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You may lead through direct management or technical leadership; formal people management is not required. We care more about your ability to lead through judgment, technical depth, and example.

You will work closely with Product, Growth, Finance, Engineering, and AI across product analytics, experimentation, user intelligence, data quality, growth measurement, AI data flywheels, and agentic analytics.

This expands the existing role from owning trusted metrics and analyses into setting direction and creating leverage across the Data function.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the Data function**

* Set priorities for a small Data team and focus limited capacity on the highest-impact problems.
* Personally lead ambiguous or high-stakes analytical projects.
* Raise standards for metrics, experimentation, analytical quality, and decision-making.
* Lead and develop Data Scientists, analysts, and Data Engineers through technical direction and example.
* Reduce repetitive and reactive work by turning recurring problems into reusable systems and processes.

### **Drive product and business decisions**

* Analyze activation, retention, segmentation, monetization, user behavior, and lifetime value.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.
* Identify opportunities where Data can directly improve key company metrics.
* Build stronger user profiling and segmentation to inform product strategy, operations, and company goal setting.
* Improve experimentation and causal measurement across Product and Growth.

The existing JD already emphasizes turning product and customer data into business decisions; this role owns that mandate at a broader level.

### **Improve data quality and measurement**

* Establish trusted definitions and validation for critical product and business metrics.
* Identify systematic issues across tracking, pipelines, transformations, tables, and dashboards.
* Partner with Data Engineering and Engineering to prevent recurring data problems rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms.
* Build reusable datasets, metric definitions, monitoring, and analytical frameworks that improve self-service.

You do not need to be a data infrastructure expert, but you should be technically strong enough to diagnose how data moves through a system, identify systemic failure modes, and work effectively with engineers to fix them.

### **Build Growth intelligence**

* Help Growth understand acquisition quality, retention, LTV, and the true value of different channels and customer segments.
* Improve performance marketing measurement beyond surface-level attribution toward experimentation and incrementality.
* Identify opportunities to improve CAC, conversion, retention, monetization, or other major business metrics.
* Build horizontal analytical tools and frameworks that enable Growth and Product teams to run better experiments and make faster decisions.

### **Partner with our AI teams**

* Support data curation, evaluation design, experimentation, and measurement for AI-powered product experiences.
* Identify product behavior that can become useful evaluation data, feedback signals, or failure cases.
* Connect AI quality with real user behavior and business outcomes.
* Strengthen the loop from **product usage data AI improvement better product**.

Model training experience is not required. The existing role already includes AI evaluation, curation, and online/offline measurement; this senior role is expected to make that collaboration systematic.

### **Build AI-native analytics**

* Use AI to automate recurring analytical work and improve the productivity of the Data team.
* Build trusted self-service tools for Product and business teams.
* Explore agentic systems that can detect unusual metric movements, identify contributing segments, generate hypotheses, and investigate likely causes.
* Help move the company from dashboards and one-off analysis toward proactive business intelligence.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Significant experience in data science, product analytics, decision science, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated Staff, Principal, Lead, or equivalent scope, regardless of formal title.
* Strong product and business judgment. You identify important questions instead of waiting for them to be assigned.
* Strong SQL and Python skills and a willingness to remain hands-on.

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**SUMMARY**

The Staff Research Associate provides technical and operational support for biomedical research studies and laboratory activities. Working under the direction of senior laboratory personnel, this position assists with molecular biology, protein analysis, cell culture, and specimen-processing activities; supports data organization and documentation; and helps maintain efficient laboratory operations. The role requires a foundational understanding of biological sciences, particularly molecular biology, and the ability to follow established laboratory protocols while contributing to high-quality research activities.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assist senior laboratory staff with molecular biology, protein, and cellular assays according to established protocols.
* Prepare samples, reagents, and materials necessary for laboratory experiments and research studies.
* Perform routine molecular biology procedures, including PCR setup, nucleic acid preparation, and related laboratory techniques.
* Support immunostaining, protein-based assays, and associated laboratory procedures.
* Assist with maintenance and expansion of mammalian cell cultures following laboratory protocols and quality standards.
* Receive, process, label, organize, and track human specimens and research samples in accordance with approved procedures and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain accurate laboratory records, databases, and research documentation.
* Organize, enter, and verify research data to support study reporting, analysis, and publication activities.
* Assist with next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows and related laboratory procedures, as assigned.
* Operate laboratory equipment and report equipment issues or technical concerns to senior laboratory personnel.
* Monitor laboratory inventory, stock supplies, and assist with ordering laboratory materials and reagents.
* Follow all laboratory safety procedures, biosafety requirements, and institutional policies.
* Participate in laboratory meetings, training activities, and professional development opportunities.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient laboratory environment.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of laboratory operations and research program objectives.

Bachelor's degree (BS or BA) in Biology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology, or a closely related scientific field required.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum of one (1) year of research laboratory experience, which may include academic, internship, or industry-based laboratory experience.
* Foundational knowledge of molecular biology principles and laboratory techniques.
* Experience performing or assisting with molecular and/or protein-based assays.
* Experience with laboratory documentation, data entry, and organization of research records.
